from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Transfer enrollment data for one university from its CDS filing."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    total_transfer_students: int | None = Field(description="Total number of degree-seeking transfer students enrolled")
    men: int | None = Field(description="Number of male transfer students")
    women: int | None = Field(description="Number of female transfer students")
    term: str | None = Field(description="The enrollment term/year (e.g., 'Fall 2021')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_enrollment_records: list[UniversityEnrollmentRecord]
